packageRules.description: Pinned by the Expo SDK, or limited by what its tooling supports (ESLint 10 breaks eslint-config-expo 58's React plugin): they change together with an SDK upgrade (npx expo install expo@<next> --fix, see app/AGENTS.md), never one by one; a lone update fails the App check. Listed on the Dependency Dashboard so you can see what is newer.
A new Expo SDK (major version) is an upgrade done by hand. Patch releases within the SDK come as normal pull requests.
